subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

Generation today has become __impulsive__ and everything is wanted at instance.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Thoughtful**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence implies how the generation today has become impatient.
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words: 
 
 
• **Impulsive means acting without thinking.** (आवेगशील)
 
 
• Example: Being impulsive is not always the right thing.
 
 
 
• So the antonym would be **thoughtful, which means considering things carefully.**(विचारमग्न)
 
 
• Example: You should be thoughtful of other's needs.
 
 
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1) Angry means feeling or showing strong annoyance, displeasure, or hostility.(गुस्सा)
 
• Option 2) Unknown means not known or familiar.(अज्ञात)
 
• Option 4) Worthless means having no real value or use.(बेकार)
